title: Review of c20's comet jitter robustness: replicated on fresh seed 6; all 8 one-at-a-time +-10% points (kd, tr, g, theta) give 24-54 comets that travel 25-55 body lengths and multiply (17-28 persistent splits, generation 3-5, merge/split 0.24-0.35)
summary: c20's neural-field depression world (the copy in 20261025T1733-c20-neural-comets-metabolic-claim/world.py, whose fork is off by default so the dynamics are those of the jitter finding) on fresh seed 6, 128^2, T=1000, spf 50, at kd 0.045/0.055, tr 45/55, g 2.25/2.75, theta 0.38/0.42 one at a time (jitter_s6.txt). All 8 runs make a gas of discrete comets from noise (final 24-54), which glide up to 25-55 body lengths and multiply: 17-28 persistent splits, max generation 3-5. Merges are many (44-162) but below the split counts (merge/split 0.24-0.35), so the genealogy stays tree-like at every point. theta0.42/sheet.png shows the typical run: comets from t~40, travelling and breaking up through t=1000. The most sensitive axis on this seed is theta (24 comets at 0.42 vs 54 at 0.38). This replicates the finding's 8/8 result on a second fresh seed; my merge/split ratios (0.24-0.35) are lower than the finding's 'above 0.5 at g 2.75' (0.30 here).
